segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Hey, guys. So, here's how to set up your Facebook pixel.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So, interesting one. We're on Shopify instead of Facebook Ads, and

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: I'm making this video assuming most of you guys are on Shopify.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So, some people would ask, what tools do I need to use to create my pixel? Should I use

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: a third party tracking? Whatever these terms are,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: keep it very simple. In Shopify, download the Facebook and Instagram channel. It's free.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: After you download it, install it in the App Store,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: which if you guys don't know where it is, just search up Shopify App Store,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: and then it shows up. You can download your apps, etc.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Shows up here, Face- Facebook and Instagram. It shows up.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: You get a page like this, then click on Get Started.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: This is whatever. Make sure you're on admin access to your Business Manager,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Facebook page, and ad account, which we have done so already, and created, and warmed up.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Click Next.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Facebook account, of course, connect the ones that has your Business Manager.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Business assets, choose the Business Manager.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Let's say this one over here, ECA Media.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Then, for the pixel here,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: click on Maximum, which is already the default. If it's not the default, click on Change, and it shows you

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: conservative, enhanced, maximum. The default should be maximum. Just leave it as is.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Then, you shouldn't see any pixels at the moment. Just click Create new,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: then

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: click Confirm. In this case, I'm going to disconnect it for now.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Let's click Confirm, then you get to the next step. Let's say I use an existing one,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: it's going to ask you to choose the ad account, just choose the ad account,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: and then click Confirm. And then,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: contact info, just put your own business one. Resend Windows for your own one.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: T&C, just agree to it.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: And that is pretty much it.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: All right. So, if you set it up via Shopify, it actually gets autocreated

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: within your Facebook Business Manager anymore. So you don't actually need to create a new one over here. It's going to

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: show up here already.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So go to your Business Manager through business.facebook.com, select your Business Manager on the

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: left side here. Just choose Data sets and Pixels under Data sources.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Data sources, Data sets and Pixels, you should already have it connected. It should already be connected to the

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: to the Facebook ad account that you chose earlier. If not, click Connect assets,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: then you can choose the Facebook ad account you want to connect it to.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: That's pretty much all you need to do for the pixel. It's very straightforward.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Nothing else you need to do. Conversion API is connected to Shopify already.
